include_primary_intents: compare grouped samples using range/IQR/variance/standard deviation
interpret or conclude from dispersion measures
exclude_primary_intents: Q1/Q2/Q3 only when no dispersion measure or comparison is assessed
probability tasks that merely reuse a grouped-data table

prerequisite_policy.rule: Quartile interpolation and grouped mean may appear as prerequisite computation inside a Grade-12 dispersion task, but standalone central-tendency/location questions remain outside this chapter.
prerequisite_policy.grade11_boundary: Mean, median, quartiles and mode of grouped data are treated as Grade-11 prerequisite content when they are the sole assessed objective.

mixed_group_policy.rule: Never split TRUE_FALSE_FOUR shared context during structural staging.
mixed_group_policy.action: Keep full group; mark mixed_scope=true when only some children assess Grade-12 dispersion.

visual_policy.visual_required_when: A table/chart/diagram is necessary to reconstruct the question faithfully.
visual_policy.source_validation: Do not redraw or fabricate. Later crop only the required source component from the exact source page.
